structured_output.what_is_happening: SRUN (Runfolio) is a pump.fun "startup app" coin. Its pitch is to earn tokenized NVIDIA/Tesla/Apple/S&P 500 stock points for verified Strava runs. It was created about 03:15Z, left the bonding curve for PumpSwap at 03:45Z, and within about 35 minutes traded roughly $620k across about 10.8k transactions from about 2,486 unique buyers. Price rose about 370% in 1h and peaked near a $304k market cap. It has since been sliding: -11% to -18% over 5m, and about $219k market cap in a live DexScreener check. The creator's token status is "creator_close" (creator has closed out) and GMGN flags a community takeover. The website shows only a one-line tagline. The X account is paywalled to fetch and not indexed by search. I found no news, Reddit or Telegram discussion.

narrative.description: 'Run and get paid in stocks': a move-to-earn idea mixed with tokenized stocks and a Strava tie-in, launched as an 'app' coin with a website and an X account.
narrative.why_spreading: It is a clean, easy-to-pitch product story that fits the current pump.fun app/startup coin meta and the tokenized-stocks trend. The flow looks trader- and bot-driven after migration (61% bot/degen rate, 263 bundler-tagged wallets), not driven by any outside event. I found no organic posts. Several same-name copycats launched within minutes, which shows demand from traders, not users.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the earliest-created of the active Runfolio/SRUN pump tokens (created 1790306107, before the other copies), the only one with this much volume and liquidity, and the one whose DexScreener profile links runfolio.org and @RunfolioApp.
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 same-name tokens. FZqM... (non-pump, ~$150k market cap, $27k liquidity, $165k 1h volume) is the main copycat and splits flow. The others are dead or have no liquidity. A much older 'Runfolio' token (3aC43..., created about 11h earlier) is dead.

authenticity.evidence: The holder base is broad: 2,826 holders per RugCheck, top 10 hold 19% excluding the pool, and there are no insider networks. There are also 27 smart wallets and 4 KOL wallets. But GMGN shows a 61% bot/degen rate, 263 bundler wallets with 17% top bundler share, and 785 fresh wallets. The creator has already exited and 'community takeover' is flagged. No paid DexScreener boosts. The dev's X account is linked to 9 launched tokens, so the dev launches serially.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts or KOL calls, so I can't tell whether the 4 renowned wallets are shilling or have already exited.

structural_risks: The creator has already exited (creator_close) and the dev's X account is tied to 9 launches, so this looks like a serial launcher
263 bundler wallets holding about 17% could dump
Momentum is fading: m5 is -11% to -18% off the $304k ATH, so the entry comes after the peak
A copycat SRUN token splits flow
Liquidity of about $42k against about $220k market cap; a 2x needs about $450k+

structured_output.counterargument: App/startup coins with a clean product pitch and 2.5k unique buyers in the first hour sometimes grind on to $1M+ as a community takeover forms. The holder distribution is unusually flat for a 35-minute-old coin, LP is burned, and 27 smart wallets are in. A pullback from ATH after migration is normal, and an X post from the project or a KOL could send it past $450k.

structured_output.thesis: This is a first-hour pump.fun app coin with good distribution but a creator who has exited and heavy bot/bundler flow. It is already fading from its ATH before our entry, and I found no organic social proof. A 2x from about $220k is possible in this meta but below break-even odds.
